degree.text: Degree Awarded Master of Engineering Degree

description.text: Teaching Objectives Materials Science & Engineering (MSE) is a major that is concerned with the structure and properties of all engineering materials. After graduation, MSE students have wide basic theory in materials science and technology, and can become materials research workers or materials engineers who are responsible for designing, producing, examining and testing diverse materials. Students graduated with honor, can also do some research, education, development and management work related to materials designing and producing, materials processing, manufacturing and relative areas etc. Main Courses Engineering Graphics、Fundamental of Material Science、Engineering Mechanics Introduction of Materials Science & Engineering、Electrical and Electronic Engineering、Material Chemistry、Fundamentals of Machine Design、Thermodynamics of Materials、Inorganic Chemistry、Methodology of Materials Science、Analytical Chemistry、Methods of Materials Testing、Physical Chemistry、Computer in Materials Science Technology Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Master of Engineering Degree Career This undergraduate major aims to develop students morally, intellectually and physically. Students of this major will be graduated with professional knowledge of metal materials and engineering and the related fields. They will be senior engineering experts, who can engage scientific research, technology development, design of process and apparatus, or the related manufacture or operation management of metal materials.

duration.text: The Material Science at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Undergraduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of Undergraduate school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Bachelor's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
